description: Use for cryptocurrency prices across thousands of coins and tokens: pass CoinGecko ids (bitcoin,ethereum,solana; up to 25) or ticker symbols (BTC,ETH,SOL; up to 5, resolved to the highest-ranked coin with that symbol). Returns price, 24h change %, market cap, 24h volume and last-updated time per coin, in one or more vs currencies (usd default; eur, btc, eth, …). Use /v1/crypto/search to find ids. For on-chain DEX prices of Base/Ethereum tokens by contract use ScrapeMole Onchain. Paid tool: x402 USDC on Base, $0.002 per successful call; call without payment to receive the PaymentRequired object.

ids.description: Comma-separated CoinGecko coin ids (1-25). Either ids or symbols is required.

symbols.description: Comma-separated ticker symbols (1-5), e.g. BTC,ETH,SOL. Resolved via CoinGecko search.
